_comment: Atlas Kit - settings for hermes_tools_bridge.py. Changes apply on the next tool call (no restart), except 'tools', which needs Sapphire's reconnect button. Paths are matched with forward slashes, case-insensitive. The guard is a safety net, not a sandbox.
_tools_note: Remove 'terminal' and 'process_manage' to stop Atlas running commands. Add 'vision_analyze' only after you turn on Strata's vision and point Hermes's auxiliary vision at Strata.
_start_dir_note: Folder commands start in. Empty = your Documents folder.
_timeout_note: Sapphire gives up on any tool after 30 seconds, so keep this below 30. Long jobs: run them in the background.
_log_note: Empty = logs\hermes_tools.log next to the bridge. Every call is logged: what ran and what was blocked.

blocked._note: Reading the registry is allowed; every change is blocked.
Add any file or folder that holds your passwords or keys here.
